# localLOOP

> localLOOP is an early-stage, lab-only research project around LOOP (Local Optimization with Overflow Protocol): a draft, federated protocol that lets city nodes describe surplus materials and products (MaterialDNA, ProductDNA), offer them to nearby cities, match and record transfers. It exists as a specification, JSON Schemas, JSON-LD contexts and a lab demo API. There are no public pilots, deployments or certified implementations.

Facts worth quoting accurately:

- Status: lab demo only, low technology readiness; the specification (v0.2.0) is a draft and may change.
- Minimal flow: MaterialDNA → Offer → Match → Transfer, as JSON-LD payloads validated by JSON Schema.
- Identifiers live under https://loop.urbnia.com/projects/loop-protocol/ (contexts, schemas, terms).
- Licences: code MIT; specification prose CC BY-SA 4.0; the localLOOP/LOOP names and logo are reserved.
- Publisher: Mycel UG (haftungsbeschränkt), contact dev@mycel-ai.de.
- Source: everything (protocol, site, lab API) is developed in the open at https://github.com/MycelAI/LocalLOOP; the former github.com/local-loop-io repositories are archived.

## Start here

- [What is LOOP?](https://loop.urbnia.com/protocol/what-is-loop/): plain-language explanation for city leaders and non-technical readers
- [Specification v0.2.0](https://loop.urbnia.com/protocol/spec/): the normative draft
- [Documentation hub](https://loop.urbnia.com/docs/): guides, FAQ, glossary, regulatory alignment

- [OpenAPI document](https://loop.urbnia.com/api/openapi.json): lab API contract

- [Schema library](https://loop.urbnia.com/library/): JSON Schemas and example payloads
- [Source repository](https://github.com/MycelAI/LocalLOOP): protocol sources, site and lab API (GitHub)
